ld.name: Mild By Nature, Witch Hazel, Alcohol-Free, Rose Petals, 12 fl oz (355 ml)
ld.description: Mild By Nature Rose Petals Witch Hazel Gently Cleans, Tones, and Moisturizes Skin Featuring Rosa Damascena and American Witch Hazel Plus Aloe Vera and Grapefruit Seed Moisturizing Toner for Soft, Healthy-Looking Skin Suitable for All Skin Types* Alcohol-Free - Vegan - Cruelty-Free Formulated without GMOs, Parabens, Phthalates Beautify, tone, and refresh your skin with Mild by Nature’s non-drying Rose Petals Witch Hazel solution made with soothing botanical extracts. This alcohol-free moisturizing toner is the perfect new step to your skincare routine, helping to smooth skin and restore essential moisture. Plus, the gentle formula contains no GMOs, parabens, or phthalates. The natural botanical extracts in this toner can help you achieve soft, healthy skin and provide many other benefits, including: American Witch Hazel is rich in antioxidants and can help to reduce inflammation and calm irritation and itchiness. Aloe Vera brings a soothing cooling sensation, while also helping to deeply moisturize and fight signs of aging. Roses (Damascena Flower Water) have antibacterial, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties and can help to minimize pores and reduce fine lines.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: After cleansing your face, apply solution to a cotton ball or pad and gently wipe over face and neck. May be used morning and night. Suggested to follow with moisturizer.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Water, Glycerin, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice*, Citrus Grandis (Grapefruit) Seed Extract, Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Rosa Damascena Flower Oil, Phenoxyethanol.

Color variation is commonly found in products containing natural ingredients such as rose oil due to differences in the condition of the soil, moisture content, and temperature. These seasonal batch to batch color differences are to be expected and do not affect the performance of the product in any way.

blocks.label: Warnings
bullets: Keep out of reach of children.
Store in a cool, dry place.
